title: Kyrie (Forestier, Missa Baisez moy)
desc: Mathurin Forestier, Missa Baisez moy, Kyrie, 1513–1514. 5 voices (Discantus, Contratenor, Tenor resolutio/Tenor 1, Tenor/Tenor 2, Barricanor/Barriton), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0017_1); edited by Vincent Besson, Marco Gurrieri, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
